story.heading: Owner operated, still answering the phone
paragraphs: Electric Direct is an owner operated company. The site says it straight: friendly, affordable, Delaware County and the Main Line.
No job is too big or too small. You call 610.853.8288, you get a free estimate, and they tell you if they can do the work.

experience.heading: How an electrical call should go.
items: Call 610.853.8288. Describe the problem. Ask for the free estimate.
Residential or commercial, they service both. Say which one you are.
The owner-operated part means the person who quoted can still show up.

feature.heading: A free estimate before anyone opens the panel
feature.text: Friendly only counts if the price is on the table. Electric Direct puts free estimates on the homepage for Delaware County and Main Line jobs.
